All shares in %. Plaza = the winner reached the Plaza. MidLast = last at the midpoint finishes not last. RW b/s/w = Roadworks user better/same/worse than the same night without Roadworks. Gated = mean place change of the gated player versus the same night with no gate (positive = worse) and the share that finished worse. MidLeader = the midpoint leader wins. Multi-gate = a road gated twice.
